meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 它在当前工作目录生成 .claude_resources.json,记录 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘和操作系统信息,并给出并行处理、内存、GPU、大数据的策略建议;不做压力测试。
howto.when: 在任何计算密集型科学任务开始前触发,例如分析数据、训练模型、并行处理之前;用户要求做资源相关规划时也会用。

say.text: 先看看这台机器有多少 CPU、内存和 GPU
分析这个 50GB 数据集前,先检测可用资源并给建议
say.note: 输出内存与磁盘策略建议

say.text: 这个训练任务该用几个 worker、能不能上 GPU?
say.note: 读取并行与 GPU 加速建议

howto.what_en: It runs a detection script and writes .claude_resources.json in the working directory with CPU, GPU, memory, disk and OS details plus strategy suggestions for parallelism, memory, GPU and large data. No stress tests.
howto.when_en: Use it at the start of any compute-intensive scientific task, e.g. before data analysis, model training or parallel processing, or when the user asks for resource-aware planning.

say_en.text: Check how many CPU cores, memory and GPUs this machine has
Detect available resources before I analyze this 50GB dataset
say_en.note: Reports memory and disk strategy suggestions

say_en.text: How many workers should this training job use, and can it use a GPU?
say_en.note: Reads the parallel and GPU acceleration advice
